# Gold Spot Explorer

**Ranks historical gold ground against where you actually find it — then reads USGS bare-earth LiDAR to pick out the creek beds and ravines themselves and score w**

Gold Spot Explorer is one of the systems in my AI portfolio. Ranks historical gold ground against where you actually find it — then reads USGS bare-earth LiDAR to pick out the creek beds and ravines themselves and score which one is your source. Overlays active BLM claims, private property lines and public streams, and re-renders the terrain at every zoom so old diggings stay readable close in. A 3D button lifts the map into a real elevation mesh you can tilt, spin and exaggerate — every overlay drapes onto the actual ground, so a bench or a creek bed reads as real relief instead of a flat outline. Tells you whether ground is claimed, BLM, National Forest, state or private — and shades the public land on every basemap and at every zoom, in a custom overlay where green means federal ground you can generally stake a claim on and red means federal ground closed to mineral entry, so you know at a glance whether you may mine before you drive out. Includes a free AI guide that runs on this machine — ask it about the ground on screen and it points the map at its answer. Scores 0–100, walkable target zones, satellite + terrain overlay, GPX export. Free public data.
